thread:
samir: alert from the console: sudden rise in fncall validation failures and a handful of customers reporting 400s. spike timeline: ~08:12-08:15 UTC.

tanya: saw the widgets. counts are high but the dashboard samples are empty. are we sampling rejects at all?

rick: default sampling for `validation.rejects` is low. ops-bot: debug-sample toggle is OFF for production validation rules.

samir: here's a log extract from Gateway:

```
INBOUND: {\"session\":\"s-42\", \"route_id\":\"saas-prod\", \"call\": {\"name\":\"invoice.create\", \"arguments\": {\"amount\": 100}}}
VALIDATOR: fncall_v2: schema mismatch: expected \"params\" object, found \"arguments\" (path /call/arguments)
```

nina: ah — SDK 3.1 changed to `arguments` field. runtime validator expects `params` (legacy). mismatch only surfaced because strict-canary got enabled in the last rollout.

tanya: why are these requests being attributed to `fallback:degen` in billing? logs show `route_id=saas-prod` on entry.

rick: runtime has a reroute path that moves a request to `fallback:degen` when invoke decode fails downstream. if reroute happens before billing tagging we lose original route.

samir: that explains misattribution. we need two parallel fixes: prevent customer-facing 400s, and keep billing attribution stable.

tanya: proposal A: add a short-lived permissive validator for the canary slice (treat `arguments` as alias for `params`) and emit `soft_fail.v2_alias` metric. keeps traffic healthy.

rick: proposal B: move billing tag evaluation earlier in the pipeline (pre-reroute), or add `original_route_id` metadata preserved across reroutes. I prefer `original_route_id` since moving tag logic could be risky.

nina: also we should turn ON sampling for these rejects for at least 2 hours so we can triage payloads. small storage cost but worth it.

samir: agree. nina, can you flip sampling?

nina: yes. I'll push a sampler override: retain samples for 2h and index to secure-samples. PR: https://go/internal/prs/9923 (sampler)

tanya: for permissive validator: we can add a dynamic alias rule in validator config and gate it by the canary cookie (slice id). make it auto-expire in 48h. I'll open a config PR and a runbook entry.

rick: for `original_route_id` metadata: small router change to copy route_id into `original_route_id` before any fallback reroute. also increment a metric `reroute.by_original_route`. I'll own the router PR.

samir: ops-bot, can you create an alarm that fires if `soft_fail.v2_alias` > 1% for 30m?

ops-bot: alarm created: alarm-8841, target metric soft_fail.v2_alias, threshold: 1% over 30m.

tanya: dashboard updates: add a split view that shows `validation.rejects` by `original_route_id` vs `final_route_id`, plus a card listing raw samples (sanitized). I'll make the dashboard tile and link it in the PR.

nina: timeline: sampler PR -> deploy in 10m, validator alias config -> deploy in 20m, router PR for original_route_id -> small rollout across regions (canary 5% then 100%) in next 2 hours.

samir: customer comms: product flagged 3 customers impacted. tanya, can you coordinate a short note summarizing status and expected fix window?

tanya: will do. will cc SDK team and include mitigation steps (downgrade to SDK 3.0 if urgent).

rick: one more thing — quota billing: even with original_route_id preserved we still bill on final route currently. ops-bot: note: billing uses `billing.route` computed at tokenization. follow-up ticket needed to attribute charges to `original_route_id` when a permissive alias was applied.

samir: ok file follow-up ticket for billing attribution change and tag it P2. action items recap:
- nina: enable reject sampling for 2h + PR 9923
- tanya: add validator alias config + runbook + customer note
- rick: router PR to set `original_route_id` pre-reroute and metric `reroute.by_original_route`
- samir: create billing attribution ticket and own comms with finance

nina: sampler PR up: https://go/internal/prs/9923, deploying now.

tanya: validator alias config draft: https://go/internal/configs/val/alias_v2.json

rick: router PR created: https://go/internal/prs/9930, marking for quick canary.

samir: reconvene in 90m to review telemetry and decide on turning off the alias. thanks all. :thumbsup:
